answer: A newcomer earns a seat by tending one summit reservoir valve above the harbor: at dawn the keeper releases a single pressure pulse down the main, and two harbor meters must log it within ten seconds of each other. A pulse logged late, or one that never arrives, voids the claim and burns a 500 POA bond. Each valve costs a $200 keeper fee plus an $80 meter fee, so 100 fakes need 100 valves, $28,000 in fees and 50,000 POA in bonds.
